{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
{-# LANGUAGE RecordWildCards #-}

module Main where

import Web.Scotty
import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.Lazy as TL
import Data.Text.Encoding (encodeUtf8, decodeUtf8)
import Network.Wai (Request, requestHeaders)
import Network.HTTP.Types.Status (status302, status403, status400)
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)
import Data.IORef
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Network.URI (parseURI, URI(..), URIAuth(..))
import Data.Char (toLower, isControl)

-- Multi-tenant configuration
data TenantConfig = TenantConfig
  { tenantId       :: Text
  , tenantDomain   :: Text
  , allowedOrigins :: [Text]
  , callbackBase   :: Text
  } deriving (Show)

type TenantRegistry = Map.Map Text TenantConfig

initRegistry :: TenantRegistry
initRegistry = Map.fromList
  [ ("acme", TenantConfig "acme" "acme.example.com" ["acme.example.com", "cdn.acme.example.com"] "https://acme.example.com")
  , ("globex", TenantConfig "globex" "globex.example.com" ["globex.example.com"] "https://globex.example.com")
  , ("initech", TenantConfig "initech" "initech.example.com" ["initech.example.com", "app.initech.example.com"] "https://initech.example.com")
  ]

-- Normalize a hostname for comparison
normalizeHost :: Text -> Text
normalizeHost = T.toLower . T.strip . stripPort
  where
    stripPort h = case T.breakOn ":" h of
      (host, _) -> host

-- Extract the effective domain from a URL for validation
extractDomain :: Text -> Maybe Text
extractDomain url = do
  uri <- parseURI (T.unpack url)
  auth <- uriAuthority uri
  let host = uriRegName auth
  return $ normalizeHost (T.pack host)

-- Check if a redirect target is within the tenant's allowed origins
-- Uses exact matching only - no subdomain wildcarding
validateRedirectTarget :: TenantConfig -> Text -> Bool
validateRedirectTarget TenantConfig{..} targetUrl =
  case extractDomain targetUrl of
    Nothing -> False
    Just targetHost ->
      let normalizedAllowed = map normalizeHost allowedOrigins
      in any (\allowed -> isExactDomain allowed targetHost) normalizedAllowed

-- Check if targetHost exactly matches the allowed domain
-- No subdomain matching - strict equality only
isExactDomain :: Text -> Text -> Bool
isExactDomain allowed target
  | allowed == target = True
  | otherwise = False

-- Resolve tenant from request headers or query param
resolveTenant :: TenantRegistry -> Text -> Maybe TenantConfig
resolveTenant registry tid = Map.lookup (T.toLower tid) registry

-- Build the final redirect URL with tenant context
buildRedirectUrl :: TenantConfig -> Text -> Text -> Text
buildRedirectUrl tenant path returnUrl =
  callbackBase tenant <> path <> "?continue=" <> returnUrl

-- Sanitize the URL scheme - only allow https
ensureHttps :: Text -> Text
ensureHttps url =
  let normalized = T.toLower url
  in if "https://" `T.isPrefixOf` normalized
     then url
     else if "http://" `T.isPrefixOf` normalized
          then "https://" <> T.drop 7 url
          else "https://" <> url

-- Validate that a session token is safe to place into a Set-Cookie header.
-- Rejects values containing control characters (CR/LF), ';', ',' or whitespace
-- to prevent HTTP response / cookie header injection (CWE-113).
isSafeCookieValue :: Text -> Bool
isSafeCookieValue t =
  not (T.null t)
    && T.all (\c -> not (isControl c)
                    && c /= ';'
                    && c /= ','
                    && c /= ' '
                    && c /= '\t'
                    && c /= '"'
                    && c /= '\\') t

-- The OAuth-style callback endpoint with open redirect protection
main :: IO Unit
main = scotty 3000 $ do

  -- Health check
  get "/health" $ do
    json (Map.fromList [("status" :: Text, "ok" :: Text)])

  -- SSO callback with redirect
  get "/auth/callback" $ do
    tenantParam <- param "tenant" `rescue` (\_ -> return "")
    redirectTarget <- param "redirect_uri" `rescue` (\_ -> return "")
    sessionToken <- param "token" `rescue` (\_ -> return "")

    if T.null tenantParam || T.null redirectTarget
      then status status400 >> text "Missing required parameters"
      else case resolveTenant initRegistry tenantParam of
        Nothing -> status status403 >> text "Unknown tenant"
        Just tenant -> do
          let sanitizedUrl = ensureHttps redirectTarget
          if validateRedirectTarget tenant sanitizedUrl
            then
              if isSafeCookieValue sessionToken
                then do
                  setHeader "Set-Cookie" (TL.fromStrict $ "session=" <> sessionToken <> "; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict")
                  status status302
                  setHeader "Location" (TL.fromStrict sanitizedUrl)
                else
                  status status400 >> text "Invalid session token"
            else
              status status403 >> text "Redirect target not allowed for this tenant"

  -- Post-login redirect with return URL
  get "/auth/login/complete" $ do
    tenantParam <- param "tenant" `rescue` (\_ -> return "")
    returnTo <- param "return_to" `rescue` (\_ -> return "")

    case resolveTenant initRegistry tenantParam of
      Nothing -> status status403 >> text "Unknown tenant"
      Just tenant -> do
        let target = if T.null returnTo
              then callbackBase tenant <> "/dashboard"
              else ensureHttps returnTo
        -- Validate the return URL against tenant's allowed origins
        if validateRedirectTarget tenant target
          then do
            status status302
            setHeader "Location" (TL.fromStrict target)
          else do
            status status302
            setHeader "Location" (TL.fromStrict $ callbackBase tenant <> "/dashboard")
